scripts.dev: npm run prebuild && quasar dev -m electron
scripts.build:electron:ui: npm run prebuild && npm run clean && quasar build -m electron --skip-pkg
scripts.build:linux: npm run prebuild && npm run clean && quasar build -m electron -T linux
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run prebuild && npm run clean && cross-env NXE_EB_MAC_ARCH=x64 quasar build -m electron -T mac -A x64
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run prebuild && npm run clean && cross-env NXE_EB_MAC_ARCH=arm64 quasar build -m electron -T mac -A arm64
scripts.build:win:portable: npm run prebuild && npm run clean && quasar build -m electron -T win -A x64
scripts.build:win:msi: npm run prebuild && npm run clean && cross-env NXE_EB_WIN_TARGET=msi quasar build -m electron -T win -A x64
scripts.build:win:all: npm run prebuild && npm run clean && cross-env NXE_EB_WIN_TARGET=both quasar build -m electron -T win -A x64
